analysis_options.api: Direct Funcdata::syncVarnodesWithSymbols invocation with explicit (updateDatatypes, unmappedAliasCheck) values over a synthetic per-case Funcdata body; no ActionGroup or other Action runs
analysis_options.funcdata: Locked BfdArchitecture over the pinned Git-blob curl input supplies the Ghidra Funcdata, address spaces, TypeFactory, and the persistent ScopeLocal; each Ghidra case clears prior state via fd.clear() (clearUnlocked + resetLocalWindow). Rugra builds an isolated synthetic Funcdata plus a hand-installed ScopeLocal per case.
analysis_options.ir: Stack-space Varnodes defined by COPY(const) ops at explicit code addresses (plus free twins and, in typelock_mapentry, a linkSymbol-attached SymbolEntry). Fixture offsets 0x300+ sit above the x86-64-gcc default local window ([0,0x1fe] plus the negative stack window starting at 0xfffffffffff0bdc0, established empirically), so creation-time setVarnodeProperties probes leave them clean; pre-states for the mask cases are built through public production paths (temporary Database::addRange/removeRange extensions driving the creation-time in-scope mapped|addrtied pair, Varnode::setAddrForce, updateType(,true,), and linkSymbol through a usepoint-matched entry) and the temporary range is removed before the sync call.
analysis_options.normalization: No Ghidra/Rugra behavior difference of syncVarnodesWithSymbols is normalized or removed. One pre-existing divergence OUTSIDE the function's contract is normalized at fixture level: Rugra's canonical TypeFactory names unknown base types 'undefined{size}' while Ghidra names them 'xunknown{size}' (printNameBase first char), so the Rust fixture pre-installs the Ghidra spelling as the initial Varnode type. Pointer/Arc addresses are internal identities and never appear in the records. Metatype numbers use the Ghidra type.hh:79-99 enum values on both sides.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; syncVarnodesWithSymbols and fixture construction are deterministic

cases.shape: sync(lm,true,true): stack symbols int4@0x300 (usepoint invalid -> symbol addrtied), char*@0x308, int8@0x318; written varnodes ti(4B@0x300), tp(8B@0x308), tsub(4B@0x31c)
cases.expected: getSizedType projects int4 (mt=14,pnb=i) onto ti and char* (mt=9,pnb=pc) onto tp; tsub's +4 partial read returns no exact piece (type.cc:4090-4117 falls off the int8 with no partial construction) and keeps the unknown type; all three gain mapped

cases.shape: sync(lm,true,true): scope range 0x200-0x2ff (vin@0x220 created in-scope as mapped|addrtied); vout@0x400 and vparam@0x502 created under a temporary 0x300-0x5ff extension (mapped|addrtied|addrforce) removed before sync; param window [0x500,0x507] via markNotMapped
cases.expected: vin: inScope -> fl=mapped|addrtied, mask=mapped only, state already matches; vout: isUnmappedUnaliased (offset below param window) -> fl=nolocalalias clears mapped+addrforce and sets nolocalalias while addrtied survives (never clearable); vparam: offset inside the param window -> fl=0 clears all three mask bits

cases.shape: sync(lm,false,true) (ActionRestructureVarnode second-pass shape): v_adt@0x310/v_nadt@0x320/v_nla@0x330 preset mapped|addrtied|addrforce, clean twins v_adt2@0x310 (second def) + v_free@0x310 (free) + v_small@0x34f; symbols adt@0x310 (addrtied), nadt@0x320 (usepoint -> no addrtied), nla@0x330 (nolocalalias), sml int2@0x34e (typelock+namelock) overlapping big int8@0x350
cases.expected: v_adt keeps addrtied|addrforce (fl has addrtied -> mask=mapped only); v_adt2 gains only mapped (same set walk); v_free skipped (isFree); v_nadt loses addrtied|addrforce (fl lacks addrtied -> mask |= addrtied|addrforce, clear-only); v_nla keeps addrtied, gains nolocalalias, loses addrforce; v_small resolves findOverlap to sml (lowest start) and takes the entry-size<vn-size branch (typelock/namelock dropped from fl, unobservable through the mask)

cases.shape: sync(lm,true,true): v_tl@0x310 typed uint4 with Varnode::typelock; symbol tl@0x310 (addrtied, typelock+namelock); v_dyn@0x320 with a linkSymbol-attached entry of att@0x320 (usepoint = v_dyn's def pc, nolocalalias symbol flag)
cases.expected: v_tl: mask never includes typelock/namelock so the symbol locks do not transfer; vn->updateType(int4) refuses (isTypeLock) keeping uint4; v_dyn: mapentry branch uses mask&~mapped (mapped held fixed), applies nolocalalias through the local mask, and updateType projects int4

observation_schema.format: Eight fixed-order UTF-8 records (before/after for four cases) with a final newline
observation_schema.identity: Fixture varnodes use semantic names; no pointer/Arc address ever appears in a record.
observation_schema.fields: Per record: case, stage, res (-1 before, 0/1 after for the sync return value), then per varnode: mapped/addrtied/addrforce/nolocalalias/typelock/namelock/free boolean flags and the data-type projection (Ghidra-enum metatype, size, printNameBase prefix).
observation_schema.raw_difference_policy: The runner pins both complete output streams via the comparand block; every record must be byte-identical (no masking classes).

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-scope-sync-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents
comparand.rust_crate_source_policy: Every crate file comes from the pinned base commit 895f69d0baebeb67db7ae27cc1ba676b8fcb4f5d Git blob except the src/{funcdata,coreaction}.rs overlays, which are taken from the live working tree

overall_status: UNTESTED: (B2 downgrade: two-sided pinning incomplete - (B2 canonicalization)...
overall_status_rationale: All eight records are byte-identical against the locked 12.0.4 oracle: the typed Symbol->Varnode projection through getSizedType/updateType (whole-size int4 and char*, partial-offset null), the unmapped paths (inScope mapped|addrtied, isUnmappedUnaliased set vs param-window clear with addrtied surviving the mask), the flag-mask asymmetry (addrtied clear-only, nolocalalias set-only, addrforce clears, per-set walk over a second def, isFree skip, findOverlap lowest-start selection with the smaller-than-varnode entry branch), and the typelock/mapentry branches (symbol locks never entering the mask, varnode typelock blocking updateType, attached-entry local mask holding mapped fixed). Residuals registered in docs/api/funcdata.md: partial-struct/array/enum/union construction in getExactPiece returns null (no type projection for those pieces), and Rugra's Varnode::set_flags/clear_flags do not propagate high->flagsDirty themselves (compensated at this call site). The pre-existing unknown-type naming divergence (undefined{size} vs xunknown{size}) is normalized at fixture level and belongs to the TypeFactory naming domain, not this function.
